residuals.interpretation: Residuals are centered close to 0 (-2.8 Wh), showing minimal systematic bias. The fat positive tail in the Q-Q plot reflects occasional sudden extreme appliance turn-ons where the model predicts modest baseline consumption but occupants suddenly activate an 800+ Wh load.

worst_failure_cases.reason_for_failure: Abrupt switch-on event: Previous consumption was near standby levels (50 Wh), but occupant turned on a major appliance reaching 580 Wh. Because no advance physical precursor existed in temperature or humidity sensors within that 10-minute window, the purely observational model could not anticipate the instant activation.
